messages.author: 69c589628735a93c
messages.subject: CIM results
parts:
Hello
Can anybody tell me how to get these variables from CIM analyses?

EWT  Individual experiment-wise thresholds 
LRTS likelihood ratio test statistic
LOD
AEE additive effect estimates
PVE phenotypic variance explained
DEE Dominance effect estimate

Thanks

L

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] CIM results
parts:
The LOD scores are provided directly in the output of cim().

To get a likelihood ratio statistic, multiply the LOD scores by 2*log(10).

To get a significance threshold, perform a permutation test by running cim() with the n.perm argument specified.

We don't have a way to get effect estimates or phenotypic variance explained except through the fitqtl() function. Once you've decided on some set of QTL, use makeqtl() to create a "qtl object" and then fitqtl() with get.ests=TRUE to get estimated effects and estimated percent variance explained.

karl
